method: Individually explained interactive owner decisions: bounded historical paid evidence, local runtime evidence, minimal cache-exclusion fix, then corrected-source runtime/access evidence. Operator-generated offline evidence supports owner review; no independent audit is claimed.
owner_final_response: I accept as owner, as I said, for this first study we are not going to use independent reviewers other than the independent experiment executor.

review_policy.separate_executor: Planned operational separation, not independent scientific validation or access/security auditing.

historical_backend_support.scope: One excluded empty-workspace exact-command isolated tool call per model, with observed routing/usage/permission/cleanup. Eight selected SDK/transport/isolation dependencies remain byte-identical. Not paid execution of the later source, a full trajectory or a billing hard-stop guarantee.

local_runtime_evidence.scope: Pinned host SDK/CLI and isolated container configuration; historical backend support plus corrected-source offline containment/runtime tests. Future entitlement can change. Final source/image/receipt still require owner-authorized freeze.

access_probe_including_cr1_text.scope: Controlled offline prompt/seed schedule across A/B/C, including CR1 release timing, hidden/reference exclusion, selected real Docker filesystem/Git-history/network/credential probes, and protected evaluator checks. No independent review is claimed.

startup_correction.change: Exclude generated __pycache__, *.pyc and *.pyo during skeleton copy so ignored caches do not contradict the trusted Git bundle. Strict seed matching is unchanged.

supporting_validation.scope: Actual1120002 offline evidence, not relabelled as execution of a later recording source. Final administrative recording requires renewed source-bound containment evidence.

limitations: Owner-reviewed exploratory study, without independent scientific or access/security review.
Finite controlled checks are not an exhaustive security proof or a hostile-code-proof Python oracle.
Schedule simulation uses a deterministic simulated agent, not a model or scientific outcomes; real evaluator tests are separate.
Soft limits and buffers do not guarantee actual billed consumption; historical unknown holds remain separate from known usage.
Relevant runtime/source/image changes require reassessment; no blanket approval of later behavioral changes.
acceptance_boundary: Named corrected runtime/access implementation and transparent prospective review-policy/evidence recording. Final source-bound freeze, prospective existing-registration OSF update and actual collection authorization remain separate.
